remarks: Cozy Studio Apartment in Springdale For Rent  Enjoy easy living in this cozy studio apartment located in the desirable Springdale area of Stamford. This convenient location is close to the train, shopping, restaurants, and public transportation, making it a great option for commuters or anyone looking for simple, low-maintenance living.  The apartment features one main living/sleeping area, a kitchenette with a microwave, and one full bathroom. Please note: there is no stove or range in the unit.  All utilities are included, adding extra value and convenience. A comfortable and practical space in a well-connected neighborhood.
